modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunkstorageo: Lets th' worlds o' Chunk Stowage Optimizer keep their .cso format with C2ME aboard.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkstor: C2ME's chunk IO rewrite would read th' .mca files straight past Chunk Stowage Optimizer, an' a converted world would have its terrain reborn without a whisper. This here compat bridges th' two, world by world: worlds served by th' stowage mod keep th' vanilla IO worker, worlds on plain Anvil keep C2ME's rewrite. Does nothin' without C2ME aboard.
